description: This file defines constants, macros, data structures, and inline functions for the OSDP (Open Supervised Device Protocol) management subsystem, including command codes, response codes, security block types, PD flags, and PD state management structures.

classes.name: osdp_channel
classes.description: Represents a communication channel with function pointers for receive, send, and flush operations.

classes.name: osdp_queue
classes.description: Implements a queue with a linked list and a memory slab for command or event storage.

classes.name: osdp_secure_channel
classes.description: Contains cryptographic keys and data for secure channel communication (enabled via CONFIG_OSDP_SC_ENABLED).

classes.name: osdp_pd
classes.description: Represents a physical device (PD) with context, state, capabilities, and communication details.

classes.name: osdp
classes.description: Main context structure managing multiple PDs, flags, and callback functions.

methods.name: cp_keyset_complete
methods.description: Completes the key setting process for a PD in CP mode; empty inline in PD mode.

methods.name: osdp_keyset_complete
methods.description: Function to finalize key setting for a PD.
